hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *inventory/hosts.yml|*inventory/host_vars/*|*inventory/group_vars/*/vault.yml) jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked: real inventory or secrets file must not be written by Claude (see .gitignore)."}}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *playbooks/*.yml|*playbooks/*.yaml|*roles/*.yml|*roles/*.yaml) out=$(uv run ansible-lint --nocolor --offline -f pep8 "$f" 2>&1); if [ -n "$out" ]; then jq -n --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$out}}'; fi;; esac; }
